## FA-003 / ZEUS-429c533aab0e revision 1 — Refs #4

### Defect (upstream, agreed in cross-review)
The upstream JSON file lease re-issued epoch 1 after its file was deleted and `guard` did not compare the owner, so an old holder passed the new lease (`review-probes.receipt.json` → `lease_deleted_reissued_ABA`). Consensus: bind monotonic fencing, owner, generation and CAS in Zeus; do not port the file lease.

### Zeus before this change
`Workflow._same_execution` already compares id/generation/attempt/lease_owner/agent/actor/recovery_sequence inside one PostgreSQL transaction, executors use a fresh `uuid4()` owner per claim, and no code path deletes documents — the expired-holder ABA did not reproduce. The remaining gap had the upstream shape: a purged or bypass-recreated row restarted at generation 0, and with a reused owner string the old handle was accepted again. Reproduced on MemoryStore **and real PostgreSQL** (probe variant `no_fence`: resubmit accepted, recreated row claimed with generation 1, old first holder's heartbeat accepted).

### Change
- `application/execution_fence.py`: `execution_fences` ledger; `advance` requires a strictly greater generation, corrupted fences fail closed; `require_unused` blocks recreation of a fenced identity.
- `Workflow.submit` → `require_unused`; `Workflow.claim`, `Executor.decide_one`, `ReleaseQueue.claim` → `advance` before bumping; a regressed row is blocked as `ExecutionGenerationRegressed` (release queue: `failed` + reason) while other work keeps being served. `Workflow.cancel` and `ExecutionRecovery` advance the fence as well.
- `docs/contracts.md`: durable-fence paragraph under `INV-EXECUTION-IDENTITY-001`.
- `docs/zeus/implementation/execution-fence-001/`: record, probe, receipt (memory + throwaway PG schema, 4 variants).

### Verification
| | Result |
|---|---|
| Probe `current` (memory + PostgreSQL) | all 8 stale/recreation attempts rejected; recreated row blocked |
| Probe `owner_blind` / `generation_blind` | still all rejected — `attempt` moves with generation and owner, so one comparison alone never opens the ABA |
| Probe `no_fence` | upstream defect reproduced on Zeus (resubmit + generation-1 reclaim + old holder accepted) |
| `tests/test_execution_fence.py` (memory + postgres variants, `HARNESS_INTEGRATION=1` against an isolated schema on this host's ledger container) | 8 passed |
| Windows full `uv run pytest -q` (Python 3.12.14, PG variants skipped) / `ruff check` | 922 passed, 308 skipped / clean |
| Linux path | this PR's ubuntu CI matrix |

### Not claimed
The fence lives in the same database, so a full DB wipe or an older restore rolls it back with everything else (INV-RECOVERY-001 / #18 host-recovery scope). Multi-host use of one ledger is not covered (current scope is a single PC). Issue closure follows the ledger acceptance path (#30) and is a separate step after this PR; the GitHub issue stays OPEN until that acceptance.

title: fix: fence execution generations with a durable ledger that outlives rows
